title: Purchases
description: Recent acquired goods, their original receipts and linked expenses.
emptyDescription: Bought goods appear here when recorded through shopping or inventory.
paidExplanation: Receipt totals and linked payments are separate facts. Open an expense to see its project and household allocation.
noReceipt: No receipt attached yet. Use the shopping trip to attach one.

allocation.title: What are these goods for?
allocation.description: Assign acquired quantities to projects or the household. This does not reserve or consume stock. Set cost shares in the linked expense.
allocation.conflict: Someone changed this allocation. Your draft is kept; close and reopen to review the latest shares before saving.
